about_the_game:
You’ve been assigned to a village on the brink of destruction.

Train yourself and deploy units.
Make good use of dungeon mechanisms and protect the village!

In this real-time tower defense game full of strategy and challenge, recruit unique combat units, use items, collect gear, and build your own defensive line to fend off waves of evil creatures.

The game is currently in its demo stage. The core gameplay framework is complete, and content is being added.
At present, your task is to defend the village for just 5 days — survive all 5 days and protect the village!

You're welcome to try it out, and we’d love to hear your feedback!

name: Dungeon Guardians Demo
short_description: You are sent to a doomed village, where monsters rise from the depths, threatening innocent lives. As the last defense, enter the perilous dungeon, deploy units, and fortify defenses to stop the invasion—fail, and the village falls.
